_comment: GearItem's name vocabulary, moved out of the class 2026-10-23 (hub token cap). poweredStaff and meleeDemonbane match the lower-cased item NAME: a powered staff (built-in spell, no autocast - DpsCalculator.isPoweredStaff delegates to GearItem) is also any 'powered staff' category; the demonbane weapon class (wiki) is the melee list plus the scorching bow and purging staff by prefix, in code; holy water is not gear. rangedWeapon / magicWeapon / notMelee match the lower-cased weapon CATEGORY for isWeaponFor: ranged when the category carries one of those words or the item has a ranged attack bonus, magic likewise with a magic bonus, melee when the category carries none of notMelee ('crossbow' needs no entry: any category holding it holds 'bow'; salamanders count for both ranged and melee). meleeStaff matches the NAME: staff-category weapons that fight in melee all the same (the wiki's one-handed vampyre staves, crush Bash/Pound/Focus - ISS-01M5RGMT70PG86MWHPF28DBJ3V, raw 2026-10-24: Vanstrom found no melee set although the quest needs the blisterwood flail); they stay magic weapons too.
